_doc: Fleet, the node side (fleet.py): a journal of what this node does, what it holds, and the actions and tests a manager (the portal's Fleet tool) may ask for. Read once at startup - restart the container after editing. FLEET=0 in the environment turns all of it off.

journal._doc: MODELS_DIR/fleet/journal.<first id>.jsonl. A file is closed at max_mb and a new one started; the oldest files beyond keep_files are deleted (20 MB x 5 keeps weeks of a busy node). memory_events: newest events kept in memory, so a reader that keeps up never reads the files.

apply._doc: Which actions this node accepts from a manager. mode: on = carry them out; dry_run = only journal what was asked; off = refuse all. allow: the action names accepted. idle_only: warm, unload, prefetch and engine start/stop are refused while the node answers a request (unless the manager sends force). This is the node owner's setting: a manager cannot change it.

tests._doc: allow: run tests a manager asks for (POST /fleet/test). idle_wait_s: before each measurement a test waits up to this long for the node to be idle.

prefetch._doc: Reading a model file into the page cache: read size per call. The read pauses while the node answers a request.

collectors._doc: colibri's scheduler metrics (Prometheus text at its /metrics): queue, active, first-output and queue-wait histograms. Read only while the engine runs. match: a regex on metric names.
collectors.name: colibri_metrics

collectors._doc: EXAMPLE to adapt: lines of an engine's log matched by a regex; the named groups become the event's fields. Set the pattern from a real line of colibri's profile output (PROF=1 in the engine's env) before enabling.
collectors.name: colibri_profile

collectors._doc: The size of colibri's routing-usage file: shows when the learned expert heat changes. The path must be the model folder colibri serves.
collectors.name: colibri_usage_file
